_meta.definition: Rule-15 rulings on the EPS YoY input (Watchlist col 18). value=null means a documented blank; a number means an ex-item YoY % (arithmetic stated in basis) that replaces the yfinance GAAP figure. A ruling applies only while quarter_end matches the name's most recent reported quarter (yfinance mostRecentQuarter); after the next print it is STALE and refresh_objective_inputs.py withholds the cell and re-raises it. Human-written; the script never edits this file.
_meta.refresh_rule: Add/replace an entry in the same session that appends the Rating Audit row (audit_row points at it). Remove nothing: a superseded entry is replaced by the new quarter's ruling.
